hero.title: Ted Lasso — S4 Premiere (Ep 1)
hero.format: Series return; weekly Wednesdays through Oct 7 (10 eps total)
hero.about: Ted's back at Richmond — this time coaching a second-division women's football team. New Lady Greyhounds ensemble (Tanya Reynolds as coach Alice Chilton, Abbie Hern, Jude Mack, Faye Marsay) joins the returning core. Ep 1 drops Tue 8/4 at 9pm ET / 6pm PT (calendar-day Wed 8/5). 10 episodes weekly through 10/7.
hero.why: The big on-platform premiere of the week. Ted Lasso is comedy (your #3 genre), leans into three of your top signals_what_lands — witty banter, dry British humor, great ensemble cast — and Apple TV+ is one of your four subs. Demon Slayer Infinity Castle Chapter I stays a HELD Tier-1 loved-list pick right below (see #1 in new_this_week) if you haven't caught it yet — but Ted Lasso is the fresh Wednesday event this week.
hero.priority_reason: Tier-3 critic-validated premiere on a platform you have. Loved-list continuation Demon Slayer Infinity Castle Chapter I (Tier 1) held one week ago and remains streaming on Crunchyroll — surfaced prominently as new_this_week #1 rather than double-heroing.
